senses.gloss:
m. (-तः)
1 A bird.
2 Going upwards, or up.
E.
उत् up, and पत who goes, from पत to go, and अच् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 A portent, some natural prodigy or phoenomenon.
2 Any public calamity, as an eclipse, a meteor, an earthquake, &c.
E.
उत् accidentally, पत to happen, and घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Birth, production.
2 Going up, rising, ascending.
E.
उत्, पत to go, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Jumping up, rising, going upwards.
E.
उत्पत to rise, and तृच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Risen, ascended.
E.
उत् up, पत to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Rising, jumping up.
E.
उत्पत and इष्णुच् aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Birth, production.
2 Producing as an effect or result, giving rise to or generating as a consequence.
3 Production in general.
E.
उत् up, पत to go, and क्तिन् aff.

m. (-गः)
1 Purport, meaning.
2 Production by the joint operation of cause and effect.
E.
उत्पत्ति and प्रयोग act.

m. (-कः)
A type of birth, (as investiture.)
E.
उत्पत्ति and व्यञ्जक figurative indication.

m. (-थः)
Error, bad way, evil.
E.
उत् from, पथ for पषिन a path.

ind.
Astray, on the wrong road.
E.
उत् from, पथिन a path, अ aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Born, produced.
2 Known, ascertained.
3 Risen, gone up.
4 Acquired, gained.
5 Effected, accomplished.
6 Occurred, happened.
E.
उत्, पद to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु)
Having progeny.
E.
उत्पन्न and तन्तु line; descendants.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Thin.
n. (-लं)
1 A blue lotus, (Nymphaea caerulea.)
2 A plant, (a Costus): see कुष्ठ.
3 A water lily in general.
4 A flower in general.
f. (-ली)
A kind of cake made with unwinnowed corn.
E.
उत् up, पल to go or grow, अच् affix, and fem. टाप् or ङीष्.

n. (-कं)
A species of sandal of the colour of brass, and very fragrant.
E.
उत्पल the lotus, गन्ध a smell, कन् affix of similitude.

mfn. (-क्षूः-क्षूः-क्षूः)
Lotus-eyed, fine-eyed.
E.
उत्पल and चक्षुस् the eye.

n. (-त्रं)
1 The leaf of the lotus.
2 The impression of a female nail.
3 The Tilaka or mark on the forehead, made with sandal, &c. by the Hindus.
4 A broad bladed knife or lancet.
E.
उत्पल a lotus, and पत्र a leaf; similarly shaped, &c. also कन् added उत्पलपत्रक.

f. (-वा)
A plant, (Echites frutescens.)
E.
उत्पल a flower, शारिवा irregular deriv. of शृ to harm: whose flower injures or destroys, (disease.)

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Lotus-like, resembling a lotus.
E.
उत्पल and आङ् before भा to shine, ड aff.

f. (-नी)
An assemblage of lotus flowers.
E.
उत्पल a lotus, इनि affix, and ङीप् fem. do.

n. (-नं)
1 Straining liquids before using for domestic or religious purposes.
2 Sprinkling ghee or other fluids on the sacrificial fire, with two blades of Kusa grass, the ends of which are held in either hand, and the centre dipped into the liquid, which is then dropped upon the fire.
E.
उत् above, &c. पुङ् to purify, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
Looking up or upwards.
E.
उत् up, and ग्रश्य looking, irr. formative, from दृश to see.

m. (-टः)
1 Pulling up by the roots.
2 Destroying.
E.
उत् up, पट to go, causal form, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Eradicating, pulling up by the roots.
2 Destroying.
E.
उत् before पट to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eradicated, pulled up by the roots.
E.
उत् up, or out, पट to go, in the causal form, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि)
Eradicating, extirpating.
E.
उत्पाट and इनि aff.

m. (-तः)
A whirlwind, a hurricane.
E.
उत्पात a portent, and वात wind.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 A producer, a generator.
2 What gives origin or production to, causative.
m. (-कः)
A fabulous animal with eight legs: written also उत्यातकः.
n. (-कं)
Origin, cause.
f. (-दिका)
1 A white ant, (termes.)
2 A potherb, (Hilancha repens.)
3 Also, Basella (rubra or lucida).
E.
उत् much, पद a foot, or पद to go, in the causal, and वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Producing, generating, begetting.
E.
उत् before पद to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः)
The Francoline partridge.
E.
उत् upon, पाद a foot, शयन sleeping.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Produced, effected.
2 Generated, begotten.
E.
उत् before पद to go, causal form क्त aff.

ind.
1 Having begotten.
2 Having produced, having inspired.
E.
उत् before पद to go, causal form, ल्यप् aff.

f. (-ली)
Health.
E.
उत् before, पल to preserve, अञ् and ङीष् affs.

m. (-वः)
Purifying ghee, &c. see उत्पवन.
E.
उत् before पू to make pure, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Uncaged, unconfined.
E.
उत् out of, पिञ्चर a cage; also उत्पिञ्जल, ल being substituted for र.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Confounded, confused.
2 Uncaged.
E.
see the last.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Desirous of going, going, proceeding.
E.
उत् before पत to go, desiderative form, उ aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Ground, rubbed.
n. (-ष्टं)
A disease, a grating of the bones of the joints upon each other.
E.
उत and पिष्ट ground.

m. (-डः)
Froth.
E.
उत् on, पीड to go, क aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Ridicule, derision.
2 Hurling, throwing afar.
E.
उत् and प्र before अस to throw, affix ल्युट्

f. (-क्षा)
1 Indifference, carelessness.
2 Ironical comparison.
3 Comparison in general, poetical or rhetorical.
E.
उत् and प्र prefixed to ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् affs.

n. (-नं)
Taking up oil or ghee when it has been defiled in any way, by dipping a blade of Kusa grass into it, and dropping it from them upon the fire.
2 Jumping, springing upon.
E.
उत् over, प्लवन jumping, &c.

f. (-वा)
A boat.
E.
उत् over, प्लु to go, अच् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Jumped upon, approached suddenly.
E.
उत् before प्लु to go, क्त aff.

ind.
Having sprung or jumped upon.
E.
उत् before प्लु to go, ल्यप् aff.
